story: After several attacks, an 11-rider breakaway formed, including GC leader Rui Oliveira. The group worked well together until the final climb, where it quickly fragmented. The strongest remaining escapees were soon caught as the peloton thinned out. With just under 15 km remaining, Guerin attacked and soloed to victory, ahead of teammate Nych.
